 items. Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the
 President.

 CALL TO ORDER

 At 9:06 AM, President Morales called the meeting to order.

 Commissioners Present: Ablard, Gallardo Good, Owens, Garner, Morales

 Phillip McGowan, City Clerk Specialist.

 1.  26-56114  Recommendation to receive and file an update from the Human Resources
  Department on the 2025 Annual Hiring Report.

  A motion was made by Vice President Garner, seconded by
  Commissioner Ablard, to approve recommendation, as amended, to
  update the Human Resources report title from 2025 to 2025-2026. The
  motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  5  Ablard, Gallardo Good, Owens, Garner, Morales
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  Yesenia Rico-Tejeda, Manager of Talent Management, Human Resources,
  spoke; and provided a PowerPoint presentation.

  Commissioner Owens joined the meeting.

  Vice President Garner spoke.
